sources.articleTitle: CM Vijay orders ₹2,000-crore allocation to implement Vetri Laptop Scheme for college students

headline: Chief Minister Vijay Allocates Funds For Vetri Student Laptop Scheme
seoTitle: CM Vijay Announces Vetri Laptop Scheme Funds
metaDescription: Chief Minister Vijay has approved a 2,000-crore budget to distribute laptops to first and second-year college students under the new Vetri scheme.
aiSummaryBullets: Chief Minister Vijay sanctioned 2,000 crore for the Vetri Laptop Scheme.
The initiative targets students in government and government-aided colleges.
Eligible recipients include those in first and second-year undergraduate or diploma programs.
aiContextParagraph: The government of India has initiated a new educational project, the Vetri Laptop Scheme, designated for the 2026-2027 academic cycle. Chief Minister Vijay has formally allocated a budget of 2,000 crore to facilitate the distribution of these devices to pupils enrolled in higher education. The program is specifically structured to support individuals currently pursuing either undergraduate or diploma courses within government and government-aided collegiate institutions. According to official reports, the primary focus remains on students in their initial and secondary years of study. This policy move reflects the administration's stated focus on providing technological resources to the academic community to assist with their curriculum requirements throughout the upcoming school year. The allocation represents a significant financial commitment by the current administration to improve access to digital learning tools for students across the region's public academic facilities.
